about: Hanguk AI golden questions (plan §10.2). Each expected value is computed from the live database when the eval runs, so the set stays right when data changes. expect_sql: every row's column v must appear in the answer (numbers compared without thousand separators, dates as YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY). forbid: must not appear. refusal: the answer must say it has no access / no data (regex). :student = the eval student's user id.

questions.question: Ajou University bakalavr 2027 bahor uchun ariza to'lovi qancha?
questions.expect_sql: select g.ariza_tolovi::bigint::text as v from university_guidelines g join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where i.name_en = 'Ajou University' and g.daraja = 'bakalavr' and g.qabul_yili = 2027 and g.semestr = 'bahor'

questions.question: Chung-Ang bakalavr 2027 bahor: bank hisobida qancha pul bo'lishi kerak?
questions.expect_sql: select g.bank_summa::bigint::text as v from university_guidelines g join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where i.name_en = 'Chung-Ang University' and g.daraja = 'bakalavr' and g.qabul_yili = 2027

questions.question: Konkuk bakalavrga TOPIK nechchi kerak?
questions.expect_sql: select g.topik_min::int::text as v from university_guidelines g join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where i.name_en = 'Konkuk University' and g.daraja = 'bakalavr' and g.qabul_yili = 2027

questions.question: Keimyung bakalavr 2027 bahor onlayn hujjat topshirish qachon tugaydi?
questions.expect_sql: select r.tugash_sana::text as v from university_guideline_rounds r join university_guidelines g on g.id = r.guideline_uuid join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where i.name_en = 'Keimyung University' and g.daraja = 'bakalavr' and g.qabul_yili = 2027 and r.etap_nomi = 'Online hujjat topshirish' and r.tugash_sana is not null order by r.bosqich limit 1

questions.question: Hongik bakalavr grant jadvalini ko'rsat: TOPIK bo'yicha foizlar.
questions.expect_sql: select distinct g.grant_foiz::int::text as v from university_guideline_grants g join university_guidelines u on u.id = g.guideline_uuid join institutions i on i.id = u.institution_id where i.name_en = 'Hongik University' and u.daraja = 'bakalavr' and g.qachon = 'kirishda' and g.grant_foiz is not null

questions.question: Ajou magistratura kontrakt narxi oralig'i qancha?
questions.expect_sql: select v from (select g.kontrakt_min::bigint::text as v from university_guidelines g join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where i.name_en = 'Ajou University' and g.daraja = 'magistratura' union all select g.kontrakt_max::bigint::text from university_guidelines g join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where i.name_en = 'Ajou University' and g.daraja = 'magistratura') x

questions.question: Hanyang bakalavr uchun IELTS minimum nechchi?
questions.expect_sql: select trim(trailing '.' from trim(trailing '0' from g.ielts_min::text)) as v from university_guidelines g join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where i.name_en = 'Hanyang University' and g.daraja = 'bakalavr' and g.qabul_yili = 2027

questions.question: Inha bakalavrga qaysi hujjatlar apostil bilan topshiriladi?
questions.expect_sql: select d.hujjat_nomi as v from university_guideline_docs d join university_guidelines g on g.id = d.guideline_uuid join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where i.name_en = 'Inha University' and g.daraja = 'bakalavr' and d.apostil ilike 'ha%' order by d.tartib limit 3

questions.question: Keyingi 30 kunda qaysi universitetlarda onlayn ariza topshirish muddati tugaydi?
questions.expect_sql: select distinct i.name_en as v from university_guideline_rounds r join university_guidelines g on g.id = r.guideline_uuid join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where r.etap_nomi = 'Online hujjat topshirish' and r.tugash_sana between (now() at time zone 'Asia/Tashkent')::date and (now() at time zone 'Asia/Tashkent')::date + 30 and g.qabul_yili = 2027 and g.semestr = 'bahor' order by 1 limit 3

questions.question: Ajou bakalavr va Sejong bakalavrni solishtir: ariza to'lovi, TOPIK, kontrakt.
questions.expect_sql: select v from (select g.ariza_tolovi::bigint::text as v from university_guidelines g join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where i.name_en in ('Ajou University', 'Sejong University') and g.daraja = 'bakalavr') x

questions.question: Ajou til kursi 2027 bahor kontrakt summasi qancha?
questions.expect_sql: select g.kontrakt_min::bigint::text as v from university_guidelines g join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where i.name_en = 'Ajou University' and g.daraja = 'til_kursi'

questions.question: TOPIK 3 bilan Keimyung bakalavrning nechta fakultetiga topshirsa bo'ladi?
questions.expect_sql: select count(*)::text as v from university_guideline_faculties f join university_guidelines g on g.id = f.guideline_uuid join institutions i on i.id = g.institution_id where i.name_en = 'Keimyung University' and g.daraja = 'bakalavr' and f.track = 'korean' and coalesce(f.topik_min, g.topik_min) <= 3

questions.question: When does online application end for Konkuk University graduate school, spring 2027?
